name: Zyrian
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Laramy Fisk: Savvy Investor, Order and Chaos's Criminal identity, who may make the Corp draw a card after the first successful run on a central server each turn. Zero-Day Heist's list, its identity swapped, with its MU Safecracker for a Forger, link and a tag avoided or removed, which Zero-Day Heist keeps. Named to sort after every other Runner deck, so the sweep schedule of those before it does not move. Eternal-legal only: Order and Chaos is in neither pool. FFG F7 Stage 4. FFG F7 Stage 14 swapped both Flashbangs for a Crowbar and a Spike. SanSan Stage 16 FFG F7 Stage 26: Dorm Computer for one Build Script Lunar Stage 1 (FFG F8): Cerberus Rex, Switchblade, Public Terminal, Tri-maf Contact, Zona Sul Shipping, Logos and Box-E for two Spot the Prey, two Mobius, two Calderas and a Maui, which Zymosis and Zero Day Heist keep. Lunar Stage 4 (FFG F8): Calling in Favors and Express Delivery for an Exploit and a Build Script, which Zymosis and Zero-Day Heist keep.
